citationText: 3 The reference to 80, 100, or any percentage modulation of the light modulator has little significance. Reference to per cent modulation of variable-density film has no significance at all. If a modulator such as a light valve, deflected penumbra, or glow lamp, has fixed average intensity, the modulation may be then stated definitely in terms of percentages of complete or 100 per cent modulation. In this case, 100 per cent modulation is that level at which the amplitude of the wave is equal to the average or mean value of light intensity in which case the excursion of light intensity extends from zero to double the mean.
